<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>كوميكس أوفرلاي - الرئيسية ومكتبة الكوميكس</title>
<style>
:root {
  --primary: #D90429;
  --primary-dark: #8D0801;
  --accent: #FFB703;
  --highlight: #FB8500;
  --control: #2B2D42;
  --bg: #F4F5F8;
  --surface: #FFFFFF;
  --ink: #141625;
  --muted: #5C6178;
  --border: #141625;
  --success: #0F9D58;
}

* {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}

html, body {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  background-color: var(--bg);
  color: var(--ink);
  font-family: "Segoe UI", Tahoma, Arial, sans-serif;
  line-height: 1.45;
  overflow-x: hidden;
}

body {
  background-image: radial-gradient(rgba(43, 45, 66, 0.08) 1.2px, transparent 1.2px);
  background-size: 14px 14px;
  padding-top: calc(64px + env(safe-area-inset-top));
  padding-bottom: calc(82px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
}

a {
  text-decoration: none;
  color: inherit;
}

button {
  font-family: inherit;
  cursor: pointer;
  border: none;
  background: none;
  padding: 0;
  color: inherit;
}

/* Top App Bar */
.app-bar {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  right: 0;
  left: 0;
  z-index: 50;
  background: var(--control);
  color: #FFFFFF;
  border-bottom: 3px solid var(--ink);
  padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top);
  box-shadow: 0 3px 0 rgba(20, 22, 37, 0.25);
}

.app-bar-inner {
  height: 60px;
  padding: 0 12px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
}

.brand-wrap {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  min-width: 0;
}

.brand-logo {
  width: 40px;
  height: 40px;
  background: var(--primary);
  border: 2.5px solid #FFFFFF;
  border-radius: 10px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  margin-left: 10px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 var(--accent);
}

.brand-text {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-width: 0;
}

.brand-title {
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.2px;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.brand-sub {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--accent);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.app-bar-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.icon-btn {
  min-width: 44px;
  min-height: 44px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
  border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);
  color: #FFFFFF;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  margin-left: 8px;
  transition: transform 0.12s ease, background-color 0.15s ease;
}

.icon-btn:last-child {
  margin-left: 0;
}

.icon-btn:active {
  transform: scale(0.94);
  background: rgba(255, 183, 3, 0.3);
}

.overlay-pill-btn {
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 0 10px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: var(--accent);
  color: var(--ink);
  border: 2px solid #FFFFFF;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 800;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  margin-left: 8px;
  box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 var(--primary);
  transition: transform 0.12s ease;
}

.overlay-pill-btn:active {
  transform: translate(1px, 1px);
  box-shadow: 1px 1px 0 var(--primary);
}

.overlay-pill-btn svg {
  margin-left: 5px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* Search Drawer inside header */
.search-bar-panel {
  display: none;
  padding: 8px 12px 12px 12px;
  background: var(--control);
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
}

.search-bar-panel.open {
  display: block;
}

.search-input-wrap {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  background: #FFFFFF;
  border: 2.5px solid var(--ink);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 0 10px;
  min-height: 46px;
}

.search-input-wrap input {
  flex: 1;
  border: none;
  outline: none;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-family: inherit;
  color: var(--ink);
  background: transparent;
  padding: 8px 6px;
}

.clear-search-btn {
  min-width: 36px;
  min-height: 36px;
  display: none;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: var(--muted);
}

.clear-search-btn.visible {
  display: flex;
}

/* Main Container */
.main-content {
  max-width: 820px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 14px 12px 18px 12px;
}

/* Quick Floating Control Panel (Hero) */
.control-hero {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary) 0%, var(--primary-dark) 100%);
  color: #FFFFFF;
  border: 3px solid var(--ink);
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 14px;
  box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--ink);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.control-hero::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: -24px;
  left: -24px;
  width: 110px;
  height: 110px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255, 183, 3, 0.28) 20%, transparent 70%);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.hero-top {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.hero-title-wrap {
  flex: 1;
  padding-left: 8px;
}

.hero-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  background: var(--accent);
  color: var(--ink);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 800;
  padding: 3px 9px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 2px solid var(--ink);
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}

.hero-badge-dot {
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--success);
  margin-left: 6px;
  border: 1px solid var(--ink);
}

.hero-badge-dot.inactive {
  background: var(--primary);
}

.hero-title {
  margin: 0 0 4px 0;
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 900;
  line-height: 1.25;
}

.hero-desc {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92);
}

.overlay-switch-btn {
  min-width: 92px;
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: #FFFFFF;
  color: var(--ink);
  border: 2.5px solid var(--ink);
  box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 var(--ink);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 800;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  transition: transform 0.12s ease, background-color 0.15s ease;
}

.overlay-switch-btn.active {
  background: var(--accent);
}

.overlay-switch-btn:active {
  transform: translate(2px, 2px);
  box-shadow: none;
}

.quick-actions-grid {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-right: -4px;
  margin-left: -4px;
}

.quick-action-item {
  width: 33.333%;
  padding: 4px;
}

.quick-action-link {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  text-align: center;
  min-height: 62px;
  padding: 8px 6px;
  background: rgba(43, 45, 66, 0.88);
  color: #FFFFFF;
  border: 2px solid var(--ink);
  border-radius: 12px;
  box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 var(--ink);
  font-size: 11.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  transition: transform 0.12s ease, background-color 0.15s ease;
}

.quick-action-link:active {
  transform: translate(2px, 2px);
  box-shadow: none;
  background: var(--control);
}

.quick-action-link svg {
  margin-bottom: 4px;
  color: var(--accent);
}

/* Resume Reading Banner */
.resume-banner {
  display: none;
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 2.5px solid var(--ink);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
  box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--accent);
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
}

.resume-banner.visible {
  display: flex;
}

.resume-info {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  min-width: 0;
  flex: 1;
  padding-left: 10px;
}

.resume-icon {
  width: 42px;
  height: 42px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: var(--highlight);
  color: #FFFFFF;
  border: 2px solid var(--ink);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  margin-left: 10px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.resume-text {
  min-width: 0;
}

.resume-label {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--primary);
}

.resume-title {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 800;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.resume-meta {
  font-size: 11.5px;
  color: var(--muted);
}

.resume-go-btn {
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 0 14px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: var(--control);
  color: #FFFFFF;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  font-weight: 800;
  border: 2px solid var(--ink);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.resume-go-btn:active {
  transform: scale(0.96);
}

/* Section Headers */
.section-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin: 18px 0 10px 0;
}

.section-title-group {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
}

.section-accent-bar {
  width: 6px;
  height: 22px;
  background: var(--primary);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--ink);
  border-radius: 4px;
  margin-left: 8px;
}

.section-accent-bar.yellow {
  background: var(--accent);
}

.section-accent-bar.orange {
  background: var(--highlight);
}

.section-title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.section-more-link {
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 0 10px;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--primary);
  border-radius: 10px;
}

.section-more-link:active {
  background: rgba(217, 4, 41, 0.08);
}

.section-more-link svg {
  margin-right: 4px;
}

/* Filter Chips */
.chips-scroll {
  display: flex;
  overflow-x: auto;
  padding-bottom: 6px;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
}

.chips-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar {
  display: none;
}

.filter-chip {
  min-height: 40px;
  padding: 6px 14px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--surface);
  color: var(--ink);
  border: 2px solid var(--ink);
  font-size: 12.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  white-space: nowrap;
  margin-left: 8px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 rgba(20, 22, 37, 0.15);
  transition: background-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease;
}

.filter-chip:last-child {
  margin-left: 0;
}

.filter-chip.active {
  background: var(--ink);
  color: var(--accent);
}

.filter-chip:active {
  transform: scale(0.96);
}

/* Comics List Cards */
.comics-grid {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-right: -5px;
  margin-left: -5px;
}

.comic-col {
  width: 100%;
  padding: 5px;
}

@media (min-width: 600px) {
  .comic-col {
    width: 50%;
  }
}

.comic-card {
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 2.5px solid var(--ink);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 10px;
  box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--ink);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  height: 100%;
  transition: transform 0.12s ease;
}

.comic-card-main {
  display: flex;
  align-items: stretch;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.comic-cover-wrap {
  width: 92px;
  height: 112px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: 2.5px solid var(--ink);
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--control);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  margin-left: 11px;
  position: relative;
}

.comic-cover-wrap img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  display: block;
}

.comic-pages-tag {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 4px;
  left: 4px;
  background: rgba(20, 22, 37, 0.88);
  color: var(--accent);
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 800;
  padding: 2px 6px;
  border-radius: 6px;
}

.comic-body {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.comic-top-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.genre-badge {
  display: inline-block;
  background: var(--accent);
  color: var(--ink);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--ink);
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 800;
  padding: 2px 8px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  max-width: 140px;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.fav-btn {
  min-width: 44px;
  min-height: 44px;
  margin: -8px -6px -8px 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: var(--muted);
  border-radius: 10px;
}

.fav-btn.saved {
  color: var(--primary);
}

.fav-btn:active {
  transform: scale(0.9);
}

.comic-title {
  margin: 0 0 2px 0;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--ink);
  line-height: 1.3;
}

.comic-author {
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--muted);
  margin-bottom: 5px;
}

.comic-summary {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #393D52;
  display: -webkit-box;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.comic-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  margin-top: auto;
}

.btn-read-primary {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 44px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: var(--primary);
  color: #FFFFFF;
  border: 2px solid var(--ink);
  font-size: 12.5px;
  font-weight: 800;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  margin-left: 7px;
  box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 var(--ink);
  transition: transform 0.12s ease;
}

.btn-read-primary:active {
  transform: translate(2px, 2px);
  box-shadow: none;
}

.btn-read-primary svg {
  margin-left: 5px;
}

.btn-float-secondary {
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 0 11px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: var(--accent);
  color: var(--ink);
  border: 2px solid var(--ink);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 800;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  margin-left: 7px;
  box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 var(--ink);
  transition: transform 0.12s ease;
}

.btn-float-secondary:active {
  transform: translate(2px, 2px);
  box-shadow: none;
}

.btn-float-secondary svg {
  margin-left: 4px;
}

.btn-info-outline {
  min-width: 44px;
  min-height: 44px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--ink);
  border: 2px solid var(--ink);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.btn-info-outline:active {
  background: #E2E4EC;
}

/* PDF Links Horizontal / List Cards */
.pdf-scroll-list {
  display: flex;
  overflow-x: auto;
  padding: 2px 2px 8px 2px;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
}

.pdf-scroll-list::-webkit-scrollbar {
  display: none;
}

.pdf-card {
  width: 240px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 2.5px solid var(--ink);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 10px;
  margin-left: 10px;
  box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--ink);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.pdf-card:last-child {
  margin-left: 0;
}

.pdf-card-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.pdf-thumb {
  width: 52px;
  height: 52px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: 2px solid var(--ink);
  background: var(--control);
  overflow: hidden;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  margin-left: 10px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: var(--accent);
}

.pdf-thumb img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  display: block;
}

.pdf-meta {
  min-width: 0;
  flex: 1;
}

.pdf-cat {
  display: inline-block;
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--primary-dark);
  background: rgba(251, 133, 0, 0.18);
  padding: 2px 7px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  margin-bottom: 3px;
}

.pdf-title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 13.5px;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--ink);
  line-height: 1.3;
  display: -webkit-box;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.pdf-url-tag {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--muted);
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  margin-bottom: 9px;
  direction: ltr;
  text-align: right;
}

.pdf-open-btn {
  margin-top: auto;
  min-height: 44px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: var(--control);
  color: #FFFFFF;
  border: 2px solid var(--ink);
  font-size: 12.5px;
  font-weight: 800;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.pdf-open-btn svg {
  margin-left: 6px;
  color: var(--accent);
}

.pdf-open-btn:active {
  background: var(--ink);
}

/* Mini-Games Strip */
.games-grid {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-right: -5px;
  margin-left: -5px;
}

.game-col {
  width: 50%;
  padding: 5px;
}

@media (min-width: 600px) {
  .game-col {
    width: 25%;
  }
}

.game-card {
  background: var(--control);
  color: #FFFFFF;
  border: 2.5px solid var(--ink);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 10px;
  box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--ink);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  height: 100%;
}

.game-cover-box {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  height: 104px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: 2px solid #FFFFFF;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  background: #141625;
}

.game-cover-box img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  display: block;
}

.game-overlay-chip {
  position: absolute;
  top: 6px;
  right: 6px;
  background: var(--accent);
  color: var(--ink);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--ink);
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 800;
  padding: 2px 6px;
  border-radius: 6px;
}

.game-title {
  margin: 0 0 4px 0;
  font-size: 13.5px;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: #FFFFFF;
}

.game-desc {
  margin: 0 0 10px 0;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
  display: -webkit-box;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.game-btns {
  margin-top: auto;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
}

.game-play-btn {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 44px;
  border-radius: 9px;
  background: var(--highlight);
  color: var(--ink);
  border: 2px solid var(--ink);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 900;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  margin-left: 6px;
}

.game-play-btn:active {
  transform: scale(0.96);
}

.game-float-btn {
  min-width: 44px;
  min-height: 44px;
  border-radius: 9px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
  color: var(--accent);
  border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.game-float-btn:active {
  background: rgba(255, 183, 3, 0.25);
}

/* Loading & Empty / Error States */
.status-box {
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 2.5px dashed var(--muted);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 20px 14px;
  text-align: center;
  margin: 8px 0;
}

.status-box p {
  margin: 0 0 10px 0;
  font-size: 13.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--muted);
}

.retry-btn {
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 0 18px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: var(--primary);
  color: #FFFFFF;
  border: 2px solid var(--ink);
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 800;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.skeleton-card {
  height: 132px;
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #E5E7EF 25%, #F1F2F7 50%, #E5E7EF 75%);
  background-size: 200% 100%;
  animation: shimmer 1.2s infinite;
  border: 2px solid #D1D4E0;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

@keyframes shimmer {
  0% { background-position: 200% 0; }
  100% { background-position: -200% 0; }
}

/* Bottom Sheet Modal for Comic Details */
.sheet-backdrop {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  background: rgba(20, 22, 37, 0.68);
  z-index: 90;
  display: none;
  align-items: flex-end;
  justify-content: center;
}

.sheet-backdrop.open {
  display: flex;
}

.bottom-sheet {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 600px;
  background: var(--surface);
  border-top: 3px solid var(--ink);
  border-right: 3px solid var(--ink);
  border-left: 3px solid var(--ink);
  border-top-right-radius: 20px;
  border-top-left-radius: 20px;
  padding: 14px 16px calc(18px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) 16px;
  max-height: 85vh;
  overflow-y: auto;
  animation: slideUp 0.18s ease-out;
}

@keyframes slideUp {
  from { transform: translateY(40px); opacity: 0.7; }
  to { transform: translateY(0); opacity: 1; }
}

.sheet-handle {
  width: 44px;
  height: 5px;
  background: #C7CBD8;
  border-radius: 4px;
  margin: 0 auto 12px auto;
}

.sheet-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.sheet-cover {
  width: 86px;
  height: 106px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  border: 2.5px solid var(--ink);
  overflow: hidden;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  margin-left: 12px;
}

.sheet-cover img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  display: block;
}

.sheet-meta {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}

.sheet-title {
  margin: 4px 0;
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: 900;
}

.sheet-author {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.sheet-pdf-path {
  font-size: 11.5px;
  background: var(--bg);
  border: 1.5px solid #D1D4E0;
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 6px 8px;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
  direction: ltr;
  text-align: right;
  word-break: break-all;
}

.sheet-summary {
  font-size: 13.5px;
  color: var(--ink);
  margin: 0 0 14px 0;
  line-height: 1.55;
}

.sheet-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.sheet-actions a,
.sheet-actions button {
  min-height: 46px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 800;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border: 2px solid var(--ink);
}

.sheet-btn-read {
  flex: 1;
  background: var(--primary);
  color: #FFFFFF;
  margin-left: 8px;
  box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 var(--ink);
}

.sheet-btn-float {
  flex: 1;
  background: var(--accent);
  color: var(--ink);
  box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 var(--ink);
}

.sheet-close-btn {
  width: 100%;
  margin-top: 10px;
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--ink);
}

/* Bottom Navigation Bar */
.bottom-nav {
  position: fixed;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  z-index: 60;
  background: var(--surface);
  border-top: 3px solid var(--ink);
  padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom);
  box-shadow: 0 -2px 8px rgba(20, 22, 37, 0.08);
}

.bottom-nav-inner {
  max-width: 820px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  height: 62px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-around;
}

.nav-item {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 52px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 4px 2px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  transition: color 0.15s ease, transform 0.12s ease;
}

.nav-item svg {
  margin-bottom: 3px;
}

.nav-item.active {
  color: var(--primary);
  font-weight: 900;
}

.nav-item.active .nav-icon-pill {
  background: rgba(217, 4, 41, 0.13);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 3px 12px;
  margin-bottom: 2px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.nav-icon-pill {
  padding: 3px 12px;
  margin-bottom: 2px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.nav-icon-pill svg {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

.nav-item:active {
  transform: scale(0.94);
}

/* Toast Notification */
.toast {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: calc(78px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
  right: 50%;
  transform: translateX(50%) translateY(16px);
  background: var(--ink);
  color: #FFFFFF;
  border: 2px solid var(--accent);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 10px 16px;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  z-index: 100;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition: opacity 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease;
}

.toast.show {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateX(50%) translateY(0);
}
</style>
